The issue was that Creative Commons license URLs were only being recognized if they used the `http` protocol. This prevented HTTPS URLs from being mapped to their "nice" names in the directory.

I updated the regular expressions `CCLICENSE` and `CCPUBLICDOMAIN` in `mygpo/web/utils.py` to support both `http` and `https` protocols by changing `http` to `https?` in the regex patterns.

```python
CCLICENSE = re.compile(
    r'https?://(www\.)?creativecommons.org/licenses/([a-z-]+)/([0-9.]+)?/?'
)
CCPUBLICDOMAIN = re.compile(
    r'https?://(www\.)?creativecommons.org/licenses/publicdomain/?'
)
```
